On Shooting at f/0.95 for Wedding Photography

No matter what angle or altitude you are at, f/0.95 will not let you get perfect focus on a group of three where the center person is in front of the others. Period.

Don't get me wrong, I love shooting wide open and probably 80-90% of my shots are as wide as I can go, however there are some situations where you need to use the tools given to you. E.g. Adjustable apertures. There is no reason not to stop down for group shots of you want everyone in focus. Or if you want a landscape crisp along with the couple. It just seems like the author is using the benefit of wide open (dreamy blurry backgrounds that enhance the image) to compensate for his lack of interesting composition.
